planning_pregnancy.text: Are you currently planning a pregnancy in the next 3 to 12 months?

pregnancy_timeframe.text: When are you hoping to conceive?

menstrual_regularity.text: Are your menstrual periods generally regular (occurring every 24 to 35 days)?

cervical_screening.text: Have you had a routine cervical screening (Pap smear) in the past 3 years?

marital_previous_marriage.text: Have you or your partner been married before?

prev_partner_children.text: Did you have any children or pregnancies from a previous partner?

prev_partner_counts.text: Please share the number of children or pregnancies from the previous partner:

consanguineous_marriage.text: Are you and your partner related by blood (for example, cousins or family relations)?

consanguinity_relationship.text: What is the relationship, if you know? (You can type or speak)

number_of_pregnancies.text: How many times have you been pregnant in total?

history_miscarriages.text: Have you ever had a miscarriage or pregnancy loss?

miscarriage_type.text: Was the miscarriage early (under 12 weeks) or late (12 to 20 weeks)?

miscarriage_complications.text: Did you experience any of these complications during the miscarriage? (Select all that apply)

history_ectopic.text: Have you ever had an ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside the uterus, e.g. in the fallopian tube)?

ectopic_details.text: Please share details of the ectopic pregnancy (which side, surgery or injection treatment):

history_premature_labour.text: Have you ever experienced premature labour or delivered a baby before 37 weeks?

history_birth_defects.text: Have you had any previous pregnancy or child with a birth defect or congenital condition?

birth_defect_details.text: What do you know about the birth defect? (You can type or use voice)

prior_deliveries.text: Have you had any full-term deliveries (babies delivered after 37 weeks)?

delivery_interval.text: How long has it been since your most recent delivery?

delivery_complications.text: Did you experience any of these complications in previous pregnancies/deliveries? (Select all that apply)

medical_diabetes.text: Do you have diabetes or high blood sugar?

diabetes_duration.text: How long have you had diabetes?

diabetes_treatment.text: What treatment are you currently using for diabetes?

diabetes_hba1c.text: What was your latest HbA1c level, if known?

medical_hypertension.text: Do you have high blood pressure (hypertension)?

htn_medications.text: Are you currently taking daily blood pressure medication?

htn_latest_bp.text: What is your typical blood pressure reading?

medical_thyroid.text: Do you have a thyroid disorder (hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism)?

thyroid_type.text: What type of thyroid condition do you have?

thyroid_medication.text: Are you currently taking daily thyroid medication (such as Thyronorm or Eltroxin)?

medical_epilepsy.text: Have you ever had epilepsy, seizures, or fits?

epilepsy_medication.text: Please share which anti-seizure medication you are currently taking (or type None):

medical_cardiac.text: Do you have any heart condition, rheumatic heart disease, murmur, or valve disease?

medical_renal.text: Do you have chronic kidney / renal disease or history of frequent kidney infections?

medical_autoimmune.text: Do you have an autoimmune condition like Lupus (SLE) or Rheumatoid Arthritis?

medical_periodontal.text: Do you have bleeding gums, loose teeth, or frequent gum infections?

bariatric_surgery.text: Have you ever had weight-loss (bariatric) surgery?

bariatric_interval.text: Was this surgery done within the past 12 to 24 months?

prior_surgeries.text: Have you had any other major surgeries (such as pelvic, uterine, appendix, or gallbladder)?

surgery_details.text: Please share surgery type, approximate year, or complications (if known):

taking_medications.text: Are you currently taking any prescription medications, Ayurvedic remedies, or daily supplements?

medication_names.text: Please list the names, dose, and reasons for taking these medications:

folic_acid_status.text: Are you currently taking daily folic acid tablets?

folic_acid_dose.text: What dose of folic acid are you taking?

family_genetic.text: Does anyone in your or your partner's family have Thalassemia, Sickle Cell Disease, Haemophilia, or other genetic conditions?

genetic_condition_details.text: Please specify which condition and which family member is affected:

tested_rubella.text: Have you received the Rubella (German Measles / MMR) vaccine, or tested immune to Rubella?

tested_varicella.text: Have you had Chickenpox (Varicella) disease in childhood, or received the Chickenpox vaccine?

tested_hepb_hiv.text: Have you or your partner ever been tested for Hepatitis B, HIV, or Syphilis?

history_tuberculosis.text: Have you ever been treated for Tuberculosis (TB) in the past?

environmental_hazards.text: Does your work or home environment involve pesticides, industrial solvents, radiation, or extreme heat?

hazard_types.text: What specific environmental exposures are present? (Select all that apply)

tobacco_use.text: Do you or your partner currently smoke bidis/cigarettes, vape, or chew tobacco (gutkha, khaini)?

alcohol_use.text: Do you or your partner consume alcoholic drinks?

caffeine_intake.text: How many cups of coffee, tea, or cola drinks do you typically consume per day?

mental_health_history.text: Have you ever been treated for depression, anxiety, or another mental health condition?

psychiatric_medications.text: Are you currently taking any psychiatric medications or antidepressants?

perinatal_mental_history.text: Did you experience severe anxiety or depression during or after a previous pregnancy?

stress_safety.text: Do you feel emotionally supported and safe in your current relationship and home?

nutrition_diet.text: What is your typical dietary pattern?

hydration_water.text: Do you drink at least 8 to 10 glasses (2 to 2.5 litres) of water daily?

physical_exercise.text: How often do you engage in moderate physical exercise (such as brisk walking or yoga)?
